messages.subject: Mirt and Bock (1972) NRM parameterizations
parts:
Hi Phil,

I would like to know if there is some reference on how to go from MIRT NRM parameterization to Bock one and vice-versa.


Thanks a lot,

Caio

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Mirt and Bock (1972) NRM parameterizations
parts:
See the following.

Thissen, D.; Cai, L. & Bock, R. D.
Nering, M. L. & Ostini, R. (Eds.)
The nominal categories item response model
Handbook of polytomous item response theory models: Development and applications, New York: Taylor & Francis, 2010, 43-75

Phil
